description: Refinery Annual Report Data Files is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Department of Energy. Energy Information Administration. National Energy Information Center. (ca. 1977 - ). The agency created and used these files to analyze and report on refinery activities. This series contains data collected on Energy Information Administration Form 820, Annual Refinery Report. Data include survey date, company name, state, site name, product name and code, supply type, and quantity. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2007. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (the dataset page says only that it "is made available with limited information on how it can be used"). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
